title: Python SDK application segment, Browser Access and by-type helpers: ID remapping, delete, export and update lookups

prose.text: These are claims about individual Python SDK helpers for ZPA application segments. Port range handling, the BROWSER_ACCESS lookup on update and microtenant move and share are in [[zpa.app-segments.sdk-behavior]] and [[zpa.microtenants.share-and-move]].

prose.label: Browser Access updates.
prose.text: The v1 and v2 update lookups are in [[zpa.sdk-python.browser-access-modules]].

checks.do: Whether a delete removed the segment-group mapping, which is controlled by force_delete.

id-lists-add-update.statement: `add_segment` and `update_segment` turn `server_group_ids` into a `serverGroups` list with transform_common_id_fields and coerce_ids=False, so the ID strings are sent as given; since v1.11.1 this is the only mapping and `server_group_ids=None` is treated as not supplied, where up to v1.10.0 each method first built `serverGroups` in its own loop, which raised TypeError on None (#575). `clientless_app_ids` is taken out before that call: `add_segment` renames it to `clientlessApps` as given and `update_segment` pops it for a Browser Access lookup.
id-lists-add-update.conditions: Changed upstream in v1.11.1 (checked 2026-10-18): previously "`add_segment` and `update_segment` turn `server_group_ids` and `clientless_app_ids` into `serverGroups` and `clientlessApps` lists with transform_common_id_fields and coerce_ids=False, so the ID strings are sent as given." The clientless_app_ids clause was also corrected: neither method lets transform_common_id_fields see that key.

quotes: body["serverGroups"] = [{"id": group_id} for group_id in body.pop("server_group_ids")]
body["serverGroups"] = [{"id": group_id} for group_id in body.pop("server_group_ids")]
no longer have a manual `server_group_ids` block in their add/update paths — the helper handles it, which also makes `server_group_ids=None` a no-op instead of a `TypeError` (#575)
Fixed ZPA application segment add/update functions raising `TypeError` when `server_group_ids=None` is passed; `None` is now treated as not supplied.

force-delete-param.statement: `delete_segment` sends `forceDelete=true` as a query parameter only when `force_delete` is true; its docstring says this deletes the mapping between the application segment and the segment group.

quotes: Setting this field to true deletes the mapping between Application Segment and Segment Group.

multimatch-unsupported-body.statement: `get_multimatch_unsupported_references` sends the list of domains itself as the request body, because the API expects a plain array of domain strings.

quotes: # The API expects a simple array of domain strings as the body

bulk-multimatch-message.statement: `bulk_update_multimatch` returns a fixed message dictionary when the response is None; otherwise it parses the body as a MultiMatchUnsupportedReferences model.

quotes: return ({"message": "Bulk update multimatch operation completed successfully."}, response, None)

weighted-lb-empty-body.statement: `update_weighted_lb_config` returns a WeightedLBConfig holding only the segment ID when the response has no body.

quotes: if response is None or not response.get_body():

export-accept-csv.statement: `application_segment_export` sends GET to `/application/export` with an `Accept: text/csv` header and accepts `single` and `microtenant_id` query parameters.

quotes: ``[query_params.microtenant_id]`` {str}: The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant.
# Return the raw CSV content as a string

export-returns-raw.statement: It returns the response body as a raw string with the response and error, and no model is built.

quotes: # Return the raw CSV content as a string
